source.dataset_license: CC BY 4.0 (KITopen record; Zenodo rendered license field was blank, API reports cc-by-4.0)
source.metering_semantics: phase active power calculated from recorded phase voltage/current; voltage/current are measured

method.integration: trapezoidal integration between adjacent samples; intervals >5x per-session median spacing are excluded
method.active_window: first through last sample with summed phase active power >100 W
method.binning: 15-minute bins relative to first active sample; segment energy assigned by segment midpoint
method.uniform_counterfactual: same integrated energy distributed in proportion to each 15-minute bin's overlap with the observed active window
method.inclusion: active window >= 900 s, valid-time coverage >= 95%, positive energy, and >=2 relative bins
method.shape_metric: total variation distance = sum absolute per-bin energy differences / (2 * integrated session energy); 0 means identical binned shape
limitations: not ACN or a station-level multi-node dataset
no connection/done/disconnect timestamps to reproduce the thesis target construction
no same-node mapping, ACN graph or compatible input tensor for frozen-checkpoint inference
does not validate forecast accuracy, meter calibration or dispatch/application benefit
controlled measurement sessions do not represent ordinary station operation
